script.title: Inaugural Address — "Let the word go forth"
script.speaker: John F. Kennedy
script.transcript: Let the word go forth from this time and place, to friend and foe alike, that the torch has been passed to a new generation of Americans, born in this century, tempered by war, disciplined by a hard and bitter peace, proud of our ancient heritage, and unwilling to witness or permit the slow undoing of those human rights to which this nation has always been committed, and to which we are committed today at home and around the world.

cards.title: Awkward long pause
cards.headline: A 2.4-second pause after “word”
cards.explanation: You paused 2.39 s after “word”. Good deliveries pause about 0.00 s here, so the listener hears a broken thought rather than a dramatic beat.
cards.fix: Cut this pause to about 0.2 s, or move it to the end of the clause.

cards.title: Monotone stretch
cards.words: new generation of Americans born in
cards.headline: Flat pitch across “new generation of Americans born in”
cards.explanation: Your pitch moved over 0.8 semitones here; the reference uses 3.1 semitones, so you used 25% of the expected range.
cards.fix: Let your pitch rise on the most important word and fall at the end of the phrase.

cards.title: Repeated start (stutter)
cards.headline: The start of “disciplined” repeats 3 times
cards.explanation: 3 short bursts before “disciplined” match the word's opening sound (frame-by-frame spectral similarity 0.99).
cards.fix: Take a breath before “disciplined” and start it once, slightly slower.

demo.title: JFK 1961: long pause, flat pitch and a stutter
demo.description: Three flaws at severity 9 of 10 injected into a re-voiced copy of the inaugural address. All three are found, nothing else is flagged.
